Specify the target bitrate for the generated video. The syntax for FFmpeg's `-b:a` parameter should be used. FFmpeg may encode the video in a way that will not result in the exact audio bitrate specified. Example values: `512K` for 512 kbps, `1M` for 1 Mbps. Default: `320k`

## CLI flag

```text
--audio-bitrate <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)
- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)
- [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)
- [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#audiobitrate)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#audiobitrate)
- [`combineChunks()`](/docs/renderer/combine-chunks#audiobitrate)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#audiobitrate)
- [`stitchFramesToVideo()`](/docs/renderer/stitch-frames-to-video#audiobitrate)
- [`canRenderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/can-render-media-on-web#audiobitrate)
- [`getEncodableAudioCodecs()`](/docs/web-renderer/get-encodable-audio-codecs#audiobitrate)
- [`renderMediaOnWeb()`](/docs/web-renderer/render-media-on-web#audiobitrate)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setAudioBitrate('128K');
```
